intro: Citadel V2 blends strength with class. This burglary-resistant safe protects valuables with its fully welded multi-bend body, double-walled construction, and twin solid shooting bolts. The Godrej 6-lever Gordian dual control key lock ensures exclusive high-precision key access. With a powder-coated finish, stylized handle, and adjustable toughened glass shelf, it’s built for secure, premium storage in homes and offices.

features.title: Ultimate Security with Twin Solid Steel Shooting Bolts
features.text: Our Home Locker is featured with twin solid steel shooting bolts, for reinforced security. With these robust bolts securing the safe door, your valuables are safeguarded with utmost protection. Experience peace of mind knowing that our compact home locker provides reliable defense for your belongings.

features.title: Godrej Make Gordian Key Lock
features.text: Engineered for reliability, this robust dual-control Godrej 6 Lever Gordian Key Lock requires two unique keys for access, ensuring enhanced protection and control. Its smooth, intuitive mechanism makes locking and unlocking effortless while offering the highest standards of security.

features.title: Composite of single and double wall
features.text: Enhanced durability and security with the locker’s double walled construction, which provides extra resistance against tampering and side impact paired with a strong single-wall door, ensuring a balance of protection and secure access for your valuables

features.title: Tough Metal Build
features.text: Built for superior security, our compact home locker features a tough metal construction that offers unmatched strength and durability. Despite its small size, this sturdy locker provides a reliable and secure storage solution for your valuables, ensuring peace of mind.

features.title: Mounting & Grouting
features.text: Designed for ultimate protection, this feature allows you to securely mount or grout the safe to walls, floors, or shelves using robust anchor bolts. By firmly fastening the locker in place, it becomes significantly more resistant to tampering or unauthorized removal, providing an extra layer of security.

features.title: Premium Interiors with Adjustable Shelve
features.text: Features adjustable toughened glass shelves that let you reconfigure storage space to fit documents, jewellery, cash, or valuables of varying sizes. The high‑strength tempered glass ensures durability and scratch resistance, while the premium interior finish adds a refined, luxurious look and keeps contents organised, visible, and protected.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. It is Recommended to anchor the Locker with bolts from the bottom as well as the back into a cupboard or onto the wall.
name: Citadel 45l V2 Key Locker
